title: Claims Manual, Parts-and-Labor Tiers: Labor Allowed When the Call Class Carries a Labor Multiplier
content:
### Rule

On a claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the labor allowed turns on two facts: the labor multiplier carried by the call class of the claim's service call (read from the call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls), and whether the tier covers the after-hours premium (as listed in the tier's schedule).

- Where the claim's service call class carries a labor multiplier above one and the tier covers the after-hours premium, the labor allowed is the labor net up to the member sublimit multiplied by that labor multiplier.
- Where the call class carries a labor multiplier above one and the tier does not cover the after-hours premium, the labor allowed is the labor net divided by that labor multiplier, up to the member sublimit.
- On a call class whose labor multiplier is one, the labor allowed is the labor net up to the member sublimit.

The labor net is the repair labor line of the failed component's price-book task on the claim's service call less the member repair discount posted against it; the member sublimit is the labor sublimit that applies to the holder's claim for the failed component.

### Truth table

| Labor multiplier above one | Tier covers the after-hours premium | Labor allowed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the lesser of the labor net and the member sublimit multiplied by the multiplier |
| yes | no | the lesser of the labor net divided by the multiplier and the member sublimit |
| no (multiplier of one) | yes | the lesser of the labor net and the member sublimit |
| no (multiplier of one) | no | the lesser of the labor net and the member sublimit |

Where the failed component has no labor sublimit, nothing caps the figure: the labor allowed is the labor net, or, in the second row, the labor net divided by the multiplier.

### Worked cases (hypothetical; multiplier 1.5 and member sublimit $1000.00 are illustrative)

Evaporator coil claim, labor net $1200.00:

- tier covers the after-hours premium: the member sublimit multiplied by 1.5 is $1500.00; the lesser of $1200.00 and $1500.00 is **$1200.00**;
- tier does not cover it: $1200.00 divided by 1.5 is $800.00; the lesser of $800.00 and $1000.00 is **$800.00**;
- multiplier of one: the lesser of $1200.00 and $1000.00 is **$1000.00**.
